**Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for both children.**

## Summary:

✅ **Alex (age 8)** - ELIGIBLE  
✅ **Blake (age 14)** - ELIGIBLE

## Why you're eligible:

You meet all the key requirements for Child Benefit:

- ✅ You live in the UK
- ✅ Both children are under 16 years old
- ✅ Both children live with you (you're responsible for them)
- ✅ Neither child is in local authority care, hospital, or fostered
- ✅ Neither child works 24+ hours per week
- ✅ Neither child has started an apprenticeship
- ✅ Neither child receives benefits in their own right

You can claim Child Benefit for both Alex and Blake. Only one person can claim Child Benefit for each child, so if someone else is currently claiming for either child, you would need to agree who should receive it.

**Please note:** If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may have to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge, but you can still claim the benefit.
